title: Kickstarting Walter Baumhofer
content: The Illustrated Press is Kickstarting a book on pulp illustrator Walter Baumhofer.The author is pulp expert David Saunders. They're looking to raise $8,000, and plan to print only 1000 copies. Early birds can get the book for $35.00. It will be 9x12 inches, 224 pages, and 300 illustrations.And knowing the quality publisher Dan Zimmer always brings to his books and hisIllustration magazine, it will be gorgeously printed.Link to Kickstarter page.
